trans-unit.source: How ChEddi works
What ChEddi is
ChEddi is an assistant inside your TYPO3 backend. It works with your permissions and only sees what you are allowed to see.
Find, read and explain pages, content elements and files
Create and change content, page trees and metadata
Translate pages and content into the languages of this site
Create and update content from a document you attach, for example a PDF
…and many more use cases
How a task runs
You describe the goal, ChEddi works through it step by step.
It looks up the records your request refers to
It shows a preview with the old and the new value
You confirm, and only then is anything written
Nothing is saved until you confirm, so you can stop at any point
Tell it which page you mean
ChEddi cannot see your screen. Words like "this page" or "here" do not identify anything.
Name the page by its title or its slug. If the name matches more than one page, ChEddi asks instead of guessing.
Live or draft
Currently active in this installation: {mode}
Live: every confirmed change is immediately visible on the website
Draft: changes go to your workspace first and stay invisible to visitors
Drafts are collected per conversation. Open them from the actions menu under "Changes of this conversation" and publish or discard them there.

Draft
Data protection
GDPR mode restricts the choice to the model hosted in the EU. Switch it off and the other models become selectable again.
Web research sends your search query to an external provider. It needs a backend group permission and is currently not available in GDPR mode.
Attachments are read on the server and their text is sent to the model together with your message.
Never write passwords, API keys or personal data of third parties into the chat.
Models and credits
The model is fixed as soon as the conversation has its first answer. Use "New conversation" to switch.
Continuing a conversation costs less than starting a new one.
One conversation per topic is cheaper than one long conversation about everything.
Attachments
Use the paper clip to attach a document. ChEddi extracts its text and works with that.
Text based documents work best, images are not analysed here
An attachment is removed together with its conversation, unless it has meanwhile been placed on a page
Limits and tips
One goal per message. Several unrelated instructions at once make the result harder to check.
Some bulk runs are covered by the AI Suite backend module itself: metadata and translation for whole page trees or file folders. Those belong there rather than in the chat.
If ChEddi claims it has no tools available, start a new conversation.
Conversations are deleted after {days} days without activity.
